title: HubSpot - Steep price jumps between tiers and billing/support frustration
clean_text: HubSpot users frequently cite pricing as a major pain point: the cost curve rises quickly once teams move beyond the free CRM, and the gap between Starter (around $20/seat/month) and Professional (around $100/seat/month equivalent) is large both in price and in which features unlock. Growing agencies often find essential tools locked behind Professional or Enterprise tiers that can exceed $800-$3,000/month. On Trustpilot, where overall sentiment is notably lower than on G2/Capterra, dominant complaints include poor customer support, difficulty cancelling subscriptions, and unexpected charges.
